integrity: The case of balanced profiles and a strictly larger head block than factor rank is explicitly attributed to Zhang; independent validation has not been conducted. Proof and exact-rational reproduction are provided, but unindexed prior equivalent statements remain possible.
limitations: The classification is restricted to strictly positive unit head profiles in one fully observed collapsed-block nonnegative Gram factorization family. It does not describe all stationary points, algorithmic convergence, or noise and partial observation. The entrywise margin is a sufficient certificate rather than a maximal Euclidean basin radius.
title: Orientation-resolved traps in nonnegative Gram factorization
